messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — kicking off the Horizon Retail pilot intake. Putting proposed cadence and asks here. Goal: pilot live in ~45 days, renewal check at 90 days. Need stakeholder list, success criteria, data/access timeline, and any flagged risks.

Omar Li: 10am PT next Wed works for me. Who from Horizon is joining that day?

Maya Patel: They've confirmed Elena (PM), Marco (Eng lead), and Finance (TBD). I asked for SSO and a sample dataset before the call.

Priya Shah: I can own enablement and training. Can someone drop a sample payload and a short mapping doc? Prefer JSON examples.

Danielle R.: Noted. Renewal risk: finance flagged budget constraints — they want clear ROI in 60 days. We'll need baseline metrics and a success playbook that ties to spend reduction.

AMANDA - Solutions: I'll draft a 30/60/90 success playbook. Proposed KPIs: p50 latency <= 250ms, quality agreement on 5 sample prompts (>= 85% pass), and cost per 1k tokens target. Thoughts?

Omar Li: Those KPIs look good. For quality we should add a small eval set from their domain (10-20 prompts) — ask Marco to provide.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Request to Horizon in my invite: please share 15 representative prompts + expected outputs before kickoff.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created for 2026-03-09 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Meeting link included.

Priya Shah: For enablement, I need an account with sample traffic routing to validate auth and request/response shapes. Can eng grant a sandbox token?

Marco (Horizon): (not a Redwood participant) We'll send prompts and a sandbox token by EOD Monday.

Danielle R.: Risk register quick list:
- Budget pushback (high)
- Data compliance questions (med)
- Integration resource availability (med)
We should assign owners now.

Maya Patel: Owner assignments:
- Budget and renewal comms -> Danielle R.
- Data and compliance -> Priya Shah + Eng review
- Integration coordination -> Omar Li

AMANDA - Solutions: I'll prep slides plus a one page ROI model. We can compute projected token cost savings with caching and batching recommendations.

Omar Li: Engineering asks (short):
```
- Sandbox token by 2026-03-08
- Sample payloads (JSON) by 2026-03-08
- Sequence length distribution so we can size GPU and throughput
```

Priya Shah: Also want to run a short enablement session for their CS and Eng on day 2 after pilot setup — 30 minutes.

Maya Patel: Timeline (rough):
- Week 0: Kickoff plus assets collected
- Week 1-2: Sandbox integration and eval runs
- Week 3: Pilot tuning and cost optimizations
- Week 6-7: Pilot review and success criteria check

Danielle R.: Add a checkpoint at day 30 for an ROI heat check. If metrics lag, escalate to account exec.

Omar Li: I'll create a quick runbook in the shared drive and ping when done.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Can everyone confirm availability for the kickoff at 10am PT and that you see the owners above? :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: Confirmed :thumbsup:

AMANDA - Solutions: Confirmed — prepping slides.

Danielle R.: Confirmed. I'll draft initial renewal note template.

Omar Li: Confirmed. I'll add runbook link here when ready. :eyes:

Maya Patel: Great — I'll update the invite with the asset checklist and post a short pre-call agenda. If Horizon doesn't provide the sample prompts by Monday EOD, we'll push the call by 48 hours. Thanks all.
